_about: GAMES 1977-79's text step runs: which one is current (the batch page opens on it, the import reads it) and what each is. A run made to try one fix is a trial until its branch merges and a combined run replaces the current one.

run4.what: the first full text step on v2 (before assembly linked all text)

run6.what: the text step re-run on the 65 puzzles whose printed lines changed with xword-ocr#18

run7.what: run6 rebuilt compute only: keys from a page's other scan, triage fixes; all text step answers reused

run8.what: run7 + two-page clue lists and numbering (session two-page-lists); text step re-run on 18 puzzles

run9.what: run7 + clue reading after a blank and on second lines (session clue-reading-blanks)

run10.what: run7 + key letters on a key's edge row (session answer-page-keys-printed, branch claude/key-last-row)
